title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 120
paragraphs: Two thousand of the Lacedaemonians came to Athens after the full moon, hurrying so hard to arrive in time that they reached Attica on the third day out of Sparta. Although they were too late for the battle, they still wanted to see the Medes, so they went out to Marathon and looked at the bodies of the slain. Then they went home, praising the Athenians and the work they had done.
